items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: He called my wife up and he said, "Elizabeth, I'm leaving out of town now

ctx.x: For 15½ months I stayed in bed, flat on my back. Not 9. Complications did set in, and that was the hip. From that turn on that Sunday. Fifteen and a half months! That's the God's Gospel truth. And you take the 15½ months and the 4 months I had prior to that with two months of convalescent period and those other 4 months, and bunch it together, I'm out, really 2½ years. Ain't touched nothing, not making a living. But even Ben Barth didn't know how I made it. He called my wife up and he said, "Elizabeth, I'm…
Ben Barth behaved pretty nicely, didn't he?
